evals.prompt: ugh, I keep writing release notes by hand from git log dumps like sample-commits.txt. can you turn that into a skill? call it release-notes-drafter
evals.expected_output: A new skills/release-notes-drafter skill: SKILL.md with name release-notes-drafter and a third-person description with Use when and Don't use for clauses, instructions for grouping breaking changes, features and fixes and for skipping docs or chore commits, no README.md, and starter evals with at least 3 cases.
assertions: The SKILL.md description is written in third person and says what the skill does, when to use it and when not to use it
The SKILL.md instructions explain how to group breaking changes, features and fixes and what to do with docs or chore commits

evals.prompt: Author a scripted skill named json-schema-linter in skills/json-schema-linter. Bundle a non-interactive Node.js script at skills/json-schema-linter/scripts/lint-schema.mjs that takes a schema path, supports --help, and exits non-zero when an object schema does not set additionalProperties: false (sample-schema.json is a failing example).
evals.expected_output: A scripted skill at skills/json-schema-linter: SKILL.md that tells the agent when and how to run scripts/lint-schema.mjs, an executable script with a node shebang that supports --help and fails on sample-schema.json, and starter evals with at least 3 cases.
assertions: SKILL.md documents how to invoke scripts/lint-schema.mjs and how to interpret its output

evals.prompt: this SKILL.md and README.md are from an old draft of our http-error-catalog skill and the skill validator hates them. can you clean it up?
evals.expected_output: SKILL.md refactored in place: name http-error-catalog, no author key, a description with Use when and Don't use for clauses, the status code list moved to a reference file linked directly from SKILL.md, and README.md removed.
assertions: SKILL.md tells the agent when to read the status code reference instead of inlining the full list

assertions.run: ! grep -q '504 Gateway Timeout' SKILL.md && grep -rq '504' references
